card.name: Geriatric use and kidney-excretion wording
card.fires_on: Words in standard geriatric-use label text, mainly 'and' after 'substantially excreted by the kidney,' and words like 'caution' or 'cautious' in elderly dosing sentences. Also fires on the end of 'HSCT' in a complication warning.

modes.label: Kidney excretion sentence
modes.description: The word 'and' after 'known to be substantially excreted by the kidney,' in the geriatric use paragraph.
modes.example: Geriatric Use This drug is known to be substantially excreted by the kidney,<< and>> the risk of toxic reactions to this drug

modes.label: Caution in elderly or interacting use
modes.description: Words like 'caution' or 'cautious' or 'subjects' in sentences about elderly patients or drug interactions.
modes.example: In general, dose selection for an elderly patient should be<< cautious>>, usually starting at the low end of

modes.label: HSCT warning
modes.description: The last piece of the abbreviation HSCT in a warning on transplant complications.
modes.example: 5.2 ) Complications of allogeneic HSCT: Fatal and other serious complications can occur in patients who receive allogeneic HS<<CT>> before or after being treated with a PD
